allowed_networks.description: List of IP networks (CIDR notation) allowed to query this Chrony server.

items.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 subnet in CIDR notation.

cmd_rate_limit.description: Maximum rate (commands per second) for the chronyd command interface. Reduces denial-of-service risk.

use_local_clock.description: Enable a local hardware reference clock (e.g., PTP) as a stratum-0 fallback. Requires compatible hardware.

ntp_servers.description: Upstream NTP servers or pools to synchronize with. Each entry may include extra options (e.g., 'iburst', 'prefer').

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

options.description: Optional arguments for the server directive (e.g., iburst, prefer, noselect).

log_metrics.description: Categories of logging to enable. Options include: all, measurements, statistics, tracking, rawdata, ratelimit, change.

min_sources.description: Minimum number of sources (from which at least one is acceptable) before Chrony will step the clock.

max_slew_rate.description: Maximum slew rate (in ppm) for clock adjustments. Higher values allow faster sync but risk overshoot.

auth_enabled.description: Enable command authentication using keys in /etc/chrony/chrony.keys (requires key management).

makestep_threshold.description: Clock offset threshold (seconds) above which the clock will be stepped (not slewn) during initial sync. Only effective if `auth_enabled` is false.

makestep_interval.description: Number of seconds to allow stepping during initial sync (i.e., allow stepping within first N seconds of daemon start).

disable_hwtimestamp.description: Disable hardware timestamping support (for systems with unreliable or unsupported PTP/PHC).

server_enabled.description: Explicitly enable serving time to clients (chronyd listens as an NTP server).

stepback_threshold.description: If the clock is ahead of the reference by this threshold (seconds), it will be stepped backward on initial sync.

sources_stale_threshold.description: Time (seconds) after which a source is considered stale and excluded from selection.

seccomp_enabled.description: Enable SECCOMP-BPF sandboxing for additional process isolation (Linux kernel ≥3.5, chrony ≥2.4).
